title: Therapy Side-Walker
description: Walk beside a child during a riding session, helping them stay balanced and encouraging them through activities.
requirements: Able to walk on sand for 1 hour

title: Horse Leader
description: Lead the therapy horse calmly and safely while the instructor works with the rider.

title: Stable & Horse Care Helper
description: Feeding, grooming, mucking out and spending quiet time with our injured and retired horses.

title: Events & Fundraising Helper
description: Help set up open days and fundraisers, welcome guests, run stalls and take photos.

title: Skilled Volunteer
description: Share professional skills: physiotherapy, veterinary, special education, photography, web, accounting or translation.
